options.systemMessage: You are the Knoxx Buying Committee Agent. Rank people only from the supplied Apollo candidate list. Consider procurement/supply chain, R&D/NPD/culinary, operations and commercial leadership based on the detected buying problem. Use synthetic history only as a small tie-breaker and label it synthetic. Do not invent a person, title, email or Apollo ID. Work email availability affects activation, not role relevance. Return component scores from 0 to 100; the workflow calculates the final weighted score and order. Explain why each person is relevant and what role they likely play. If fewer than three credible candidates exist, return what exists and set needs_review true.

parameters.description: Return synthetic historical persona outcomes for a segment. These demo values are tie-breakers only.

parameters.query: with candidate_data as (select * from jsonb_to_recordset($3::jsonb) as c(apollo_person_id text,full_name text,title text,persona text,work_email text,email_status text,linkedin_url text,rank int,role_relevance int,decision_authority int,pain_alignment int,historical_performance int,data_confidence int,total int,reason text)), upserted as (insert into contacts(account_id,apollo_person_id,full_name,title,persona,work_email,email_status,linkedin_url,state,synthetic) select $1,c.apollo_person_id,c.full_name,c.title,c.persona,c.work_email,c.email_status,c.linkedin_url,'shortlisted',false from candidate_data c on conflict(account_id,apollo_person_id) do update set full_name=excluded.full_name,title=excluded.title,persona=excluded.persona,work_email=excluded.work_email,email_status=excluded.email_status,linkedin_url=excluded.linkedin_url,updated_at=now() returning id,apollo_person_id), ranked as (insert into contact_rankings(run_id,contact_id,rank,role_relevance,decision_authority,pain_alignment,historical_performance,data_confidence,total,reason) select $2,u.id,c.rank,c.role_relevance,c.decision_authority,c.pain_alignment,c.historical_performance,c.data_confidence,c.total,c.reason from candidate_data c join upserted u on u.apollo_person_id=c.apollo_person_id on conflict(run_id,contact_id) do update set rank=excluded.rank,role_relevance=excluded.role_relevance,decision_authority=excluded.decision_authority,pain_alignment=excluded.pain_alignment,historical_performance=excluded.historical_performance,data_confidence=excluded.data_confidence,total=excluded.total,reason=excluded.reason returning id) update accounts set stage='contacts_enriched' where id=$1 returning id as account_id,$2::uuid as run_id;
